notes.title: Version 1.2.1
notes.content:
- redesigned the main storyline
- added a new menu: game story
- added new triggers to open the story
- two new buttons have been added on the level cards, which allow you to navigate to the necessary information in the user's guide and story.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
A new level has been added - Crash.

 - added new mechanics - glitch effect
 - buying and unlocking levels has become more enjoyable
 - in future patches, it is planned to change the order of the levels and add a full-fledged story.

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
A new level has been added - Coming Storm.

Graphics has improved.
 - the space background is now less bright. In the settings, you can change  the brightness of the background is to your liking.
- improved mechanics of destruction of objects, teleport and laser.
 - added post processing: vignette, glow and chromatic aberration. You can also adjust these settings to your liking or turn them off post processing.

Now the game continues by pressing the Esc key. 
You can exit the menu by pressing the space bar (the "confirm" action), but this works only during a pause.
